views.sql:
create or replace view public.post_public_metrics
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  posts.id as post_id,
  count(distinct post_hearts.profile_id) as heart_count,
  count(distinct comments.id) filter (where comments.deleted_at is null) as comment_count,
  count(distinct version_hearts.profile_id) as featured_version_heart_count
from public.posts
left join public.post_hearts on post_hearts.post_id = posts.id
left join public.comments on comments.post_id = posts.id
left join public.single_posts on single_posts.post_id = posts.id
left join public.version_hearts on version_hearts.song_version_id = single_posts.featured_version_id
group by posts.id;

views.name: profile_public_metrics
views.sql:
create or replace view public.profile_public_metrics
with (security_invoker = true)
as
with follower_counts as (
  select
    follows.followed_id as profile_id,
    count(*)::integer as followers_count
  from public.follows
  group by follows.followed_id
),
following_counts as (
  select
    follows.follower_id as profile_id,
    count(*)::integer as following_count
  from public.follows
  group by follows.follower_id
),
public_post_counts as (
  select
    posts.owner_id as profile_id,
    count(*)::integer as public_posts_count,
    count(*) filter (where posts.post_type = 'single')::integer as single_count,
    count(*) filter (where posts.post_type = 'ep')::integer as ep_count,
    count(*) filter (where posts.post_type = 'album')::integer as album_count,
    max(posts.activity_at) as last_public_activity_at
  from public.posts
  where posts.visibility = 'public'
  group by posts.owner_id
)
select
  profiles.id as profile_id,
  coalesce(follower_counts.followers_count, 0)::integer as followers_count,
  coalesce(following_counts.following_count, 0)::integer as following_count,
  coalesce(public_post_counts.public_posts_count, 0)::integer as public_posts_count,
  coalesce(public_post_counts.single_count, 0)::integer as single_count,
  coalesce(public_post_counts.ep_count, 0)::integer as ep_count,
  coalesce(public_post_counts.album_count, 0)::integer as album_count,
  public_post_counts.last_public_activity_at
from public.profiles
left join follower_counts
  on follower_counts.profile_id = profiles.id
left join following_counts
  on following_counts.profile_id = profiles.id
left join public_post_counts
  on public_post_counts.profile_id = profiles.id;

stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.protected_media_assets as asset
    where asset.id = target_asset_id
      and asset.status = 'ready'
      and asset.deleted_at is null
      and (asset.expires_at is null or asset.expires_at > timezone('utc', now()))
      and not public.is_profile_blocked_pair(asset.owner_id, target_profile_id)
      and (
        asset.owner_id = target_profile_id
        or (
          asset.message_id is not null
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.messages as message
            where message.id = asset.message_id
              and public.is_conversation_member(message.conversation_id, target_profile_id)
          )
        )
        or (
          asset.post_id is not null
          and public.can_view_post(asset.post_id, target_profile_id)
        )
        or (
          asset.project_id is not null
          and public.can_view_collaboration_project(asset.project_id, target_profile_id)
        )
        or (
          supplied_share_token is not null
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.share_links as share_link
            where share_link.token_hash = encode(
              extensions.digest(supplied_share_token, 'sha256'),
              'hex'
            )
              and share_link.is_active = true
              and share_link.revoked_at is null
              and (share_link.expires_at is null or share_link.expires_at > timezone('utc', now()))
              and (share_link.max_uses is null or share_link.use_count <= share_link.max_uses)
              and (
                (share_link.target_type = 'post' and share_link.target_id = asset.post_id)
                or (
                  share_link.target_type = 'collaboration_project'
                  and share_link.target_id = asset.project_id
                )
                or (
                  share_link.target_type = 'song_version'
                  and share_link.target_id = asset.song_version_id
                )
              )
          )
        )
      )
  );
$$;

create function public.claim_push_delivery_batch(batch_size integer default 20)
returns table (

  notification_id uuid,
  recipient_id uuid,

set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
begin
  if coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'Service role required.';
  end if;

  return query
  with claimed as (
    select queue.id
    from public.push_delivery_queue as queue
    where queue.status in ('pending', 'failed')
      and queue.available_at <= timezone('utc', now())
    order by queue.created_at asc
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(batch_size, 1)
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.push_delivery_queue as queue
    set
      status = 'processing',
      locked_at = timezone('utc', now()),
      locked_by = coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''), 'service-role'),
      updated_at = timezone('utc', now())
    from claimed
    where queue.id = claimed.id
    returning queue.*
  )
  select
    updated.id as queue_item_id,
    updated.notification_id,
    updated.recipient_id,
    subscriptions.id as subscription_id,
    subscriptions.endpoint,
    subscriptions.p256dh,
    subscriptions.auth,
    notification.type as notification_type,
    notification.context as notification_context,
    notification.post_id,
    notification.project_id,
    notification.song_version_id,
    notification.comment_id,
    notification.conversation_id,
    actor.display_name as actor_display_name,
    actor.username as actor_username,
    post.title as post_title,
    coalesce(preference.privacy_safe_push, true) as privacy_safe_push
  from updated
  join public.notifications as notification
    on notification.id = updated.notification_id
  join public.push_subscriptions as subscriptions
    on subscriptions.profile_id = updated.recipient_id
   and subscriptions.is_active = true
  left join public.notification_preferences as preference
    on preference.profile_id = updated.recipient_id
  left join public.profiles as actor
    on actor.id = notification.actor_id
  left join public.posts as post
    on post.id = notification.post_id;
end;
$$;

      where existing.recipient_id = follow.follower_id
        and existing.actor_id = new.owner_id
        and existing.type = 'release_update'

  if not public.can_review_project(target_project_id, current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'You cannot add feedback to this project.';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.collaboration_project_tracks
    where id = target_track_id
      and project_id = target_project_id
      and song_id = (
        select song_id from public.song_versions where id = target_song_version_id
      )
  ) then

    target_project_id,
    target_track_id,
    target_song_version_id,
    current_user_id,
    feedback_start_seconds,
    feedback_end_seconds,
    nullif(btrim(feedback_title), ''),
    btrim(feedback_body),
    feedback_category,
    feedback_priority,

  insert into public.collaboration_activity (
    project_id,
    actor_id,
    activity_type,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    target_project_id,
    current_user_id,
    'feedback_added',
    'feedback',
    new_thread_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'track_id', target_track_id,
      'song_version_id', target_song_version_id,
      'start_seconds', feedback_start_seconds
    )
  );

  insert into public.notifications (
    recipient_id,
    actor_id,
    type,
    project_id,
    song_version_id
  )
  select
    member.profile_id,
    current_user_id,

  from public.collaboration_project_members as member
  where member.project_id = target_project_id

    and member.profile_id <> current_user_id
    and (
      feedback_assigned_to is null
      or member.profile_id = feedback_assigned_to
    );

  return new_thread_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.create_release_post(
  next_post_type text,
  next_title text,
  next_description text default null,
  next_release_url text default null,
  next_artwork_asset_id uuid default null,
  next_visibility text default 'public',
  next_tracks jsonb default '[]'::jsonb
)
returns public.posts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  created_post public.posts%rowtype;
  normalized_title text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(next_title), ''), 'Untitled release');
  normalized_description text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(next_description, '')), '');
  normalized_release_url text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(next_release_url, '')), '');
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required.';
  end if;

  if next_post_type not in ('ep', 'album') then
    raise exception 'Release posts must be EPs or albums.';
  end if;

  begin
    insert into public.posts (
      owner_id,
      post_type,
      title,
      description,
      release_url,
      artwork_asset_id,
      visibility,
      is_published,
      published_at,
      activity_at
    )
    values (
      current_user_id,
      next_post_type,
      normalized_title,
      normalized_description,
      normalized_release_url,
      next_artwork_asset_id,
      next_visibility,
      next_visibility <> 'private',
      case when next_visibility <> 'private' then timezone('utc', now()) else null end,
      timezone('utc', now())
    )
    returning *
    into created_post;

    perform public.update_release_post(
      created_post.id,
      normalized_title,
      coalesce(normalized_description, ''),
      coalesce(normalized_release_url, ''),
      next_artwork_asset_id,
      coalesce(next_tracks, '[]'::jsonb)
    );

    select *
    into created_post
    from public.posts
    where id = created_post.id;

    return created_post;
  exception
    when others then
      if created_post.id is not null then
        delete from public.posts
        where id = created_post.id;
      end if;
      raise;
  end;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.create_shared_feedback_thread(
  supplied_token text,
  target_track_id uuid,
  target_song_version_id uuid,
  feedback_start_seconds numeric,
  feedback_end_seconds numeric,
  feedback_title text,
  feedback_body text,
  feedback_category text default 'general',
  feedback_priority text default 'normal'
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  target_link public.share_links%rowtype;
  target_track public.collaboration_project_tracks%rowtype;
  new_thread_id uuid;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Sign in to leave review feedback.';
  end if;

  select * into target_link
  from public.share_links
  where token_hash = encode(extensions.digest(supplied_token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    and target_type in ('collaboration_project', 'song_version');

  if target_link.id is null
    or target_link.permission <> 'review'
    or not target_link.is_active
    or target_link.revoked_at is not null
    or (target_link.expires_at is not null and target_link.expires_at <= timezone('utc', now()))
    or public.is_profile_blocked_pair(target_link.owner_id, current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'This review link is unavailable.';
  end if;

  select * into target_track
  from public.collaboration_project_tracks
  where id = target_track_id;

  if target_track.id is null
    or not exists (
      select 1 from public.song_versions as version
      where version.id = target_song_version_id
        and version.song_id = target_track.song_id
        and version.collaboration_project_id = target_track.project_id
    )
    or (
      target_link.target_type = 'collaboration_project'
      and target_link.target_id <> target_track.project_id
    )
    or (
      target_link.target_type = 'song_version'
      and target_link.target_id <> target_song_version_id
    ) then
    raise exception 'The shared review target does not match this version.';
  end if;

  if feedback_start_seconds < 0
    or (feedback_end_seconds is not null and feedback_end_seconds < feedback_start_seconds)
    or char_length(btrim(feedback_body)) not between 1 and 5000
    or feedback_category not in ('general', 'arrangement', 'mix', 'vocals', 'lyrics', 'sound_design', 'mastering', 'performance', 'technical')
    or feedback_priority not in ('low', 'normal', 'high', 'blocking') then
    raise exception 'The feedback details are invalid.';
  end if;

  insert into public.feedback_threads (
    project_id,
    track_id,
    song_version_id,
    author_id,
    start_seconds,
    end_seconds,
    title,
    body,
    category,
    priority
  )
  values (
    target_track.project_id,
    target_track_id,
    target_song_version_id,
    current_user_id,
    feedback_start_seconds,
    feedback_end_seconds,
    nullif(btrim(feedback_title), ''),
    btrim(feedback_body),
    feedback_category,
    feedback_priority
  )
  returning id into new_thread_id;

  insert into public.collaboration_activity (
    project_id,
    actor_id,
    activity_type,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    target_track.project_id,
    current_user_id,
    'feedback_added',
    'feedback',
    new_thread_id,
    jsonb_build_object('source', 'review_link', 'track_id', target_track_id)
  );

  insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type, project_id, song_version_id)
  values (target_link.owner_id, current_user_id, 'share_link_review', target_track.project_id, target_song_version_id);

  return new_thread_id;
end;
$$;

functions.sql:
create or replace function public.finalize_protected_media_asset(
  target_asset_id uuid,
  actual_bytes bigint,
  target_checksum text default null,
  target_duration_seconds numeric default null,
  target_width integer default null,
  target_height integer default null,
  target_waveform_data jsonb default null
)
returns public.protected_media_assets
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  asset public.protected_media_assets%rowtype;
  quota public.protected_media_quotas%rowtype;
  safe_actual_bytes bigint := greatest(coalesce(actual_bytes, 0), 0);
  is_attachment boolean;
begin
  select *
  into asset
  from public.protected_media_assets
  where id = target_asset_id
  for update;

  if asset.id is null or asset.status not in ('reserved', 'processing') then
    raise exception 'Protected media reservation is unavailable.';
  end if;

  select *
  into quota
  from public.protected_media_quotas
  where profile_id = asset.owner_id
  for update;

  is_attachment := asset.purpose in ('message_audio', 'message_image', 'message_document');

  if quota.used_bytes + greatest(0, quota.reserved_bytes - asset.reserved_bytes) + safe_actual_bytes > quota.protected_limit_bytes then
    raise exception 'Protected media quota exceeded.';
  end if;

  if is_attachment
    and quota.attachment_used_bytes
      + greatest(0, quota.attachment_reserved_bytes - asset.reserved_bytes)
      + safe_actual_bytes > quota.attachment_limit_bytes then
    raise exception 'Message attachment quota exceeded.';
  end if;

  update public.protected_media_quotas
  set
    reserved_bytes = greatest(0, reserved_bytes - asset.reserved_bytes),
    attachment_reserved_bytes = greatest(
      0,
      attachment_reserved_bytes - case when is_attachment then asset.reserved_bytes else 0 end
    ),
    used_bytes = used_bytes + safe_actual_bytes,
    attachment_used_bytes = attachment_used_bytes + case when is_attachment then safe_actual_bytes else 0 end
  where profile_id = asset.owner_id;

  update public.protected_media_assets
  set
    status = 'ready',
    bytes = safe_actual_bytes,
    reserved_bytes = 0,
    checksum = target_checksum,
    duration_seconds = target_duration_seconds,
    width = target_width,
    height = target_height,
    waveform_data = target_waveform_data,
    ready_at = timezone('utc', now())
  where id = target_asset_id
  returning * into asset;

  return asset;
end;
$$;

functions.sql:
create or replace function public.get_admin_dashboard_v1(activity_days integer default 14)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  requested_days integer := greatest(7, least(coalesce(activity_days, 14), 90));
  dashboard jsonb;
begin
  if not public.is_app_admin(auth.uid(), 'moderator') then
    raise exception 'Administrator access required.';
  end if;

  with public_posts as materialized (
    select post.*
    from public.posts as post
    where post.visibility = 'public'
      and post.is_published
      and post.hidden_at is null
  ),
  public_comments as materialized (
    select comment.*
    from public.comments as comment
    join public_posts as post on post.id = comment.post_id
    where comment.deleted_at is null
  ),
  public_profiles as materialized (
    select profile.*
    from public.profiles as profile
    left join public.profile_privacy_settings as privacy
      on privacy.profile_id = profile.id
    where profile.deactivated_at is null
      and coalesce(privacy.profile_visibility, 'public') = 'public'
      and coalesce(privacy.allow_profile_discovery, true)
  ),
  public_asset_usage as materialized (
    select post.artwork_asset_id as asset_id, post.id as post_id
    from public_posts as post
    where post.artwork_asset_id is not null
    union
    select track.preview_asset_id, track.post_id
    from public.release_tracks as track
    join public_posts as post on post.id = track.post_id
    where track.preview_asset_id is not null
    union
    select version.preview_asset_id, single.post_id
    from public.single_posts as single
    join public_posts as post on post.id = single.post_id
    join public.song_versions as version on version.id = single.featured_version_id
    where version.preview_asset_id is not null
  ),
  public_assets as materialized (
    select distinct asset.*
    from public.assets as asset
    join public_asset_usage as usage on usage.asset_id = asset.id
    where asset.asset_type in ('audio_preview', 'cover_artwork')
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'generated_at', timezone('utc', now()),
    'window_days', requested_days,
    'privacy_boundary', jsonb_build_object(
      'public_releases_only', true,
      'public_comments_only', true,
      'discoverable_profiles_only', true,
      'private_assets_excluded', true,
      'messages_excluded', true
    ),
    'totals', jsonb_build_object(
      'public_releases', (select count(*) from public_posts),
      'public_comments', (select count(*) from public_comments),
      'discoverable_creators', (select count(*) from public_profiles),
      'public_media_assets', (select count(*) from public_assets),
      'public_media_bytes', (select coalesce(sum(asset.bytes), 0) from public_assets as asset),
      'open_reports', (
        select count(*)
        from public.reports as report
        where report.status in ('open', 'reviewing')
      ),
      'reports_last_30_days', (
        select count(*)
        from public.reports as report
        where report.created_at >= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '30 days'
      )
    ),
    'daily_activity', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'date', activity_day.day::date,
          'releases', (
            select count(*)
            from public_posts as post
            where coalesce(post.published_at, post.created_at) >= activity_day.day
              and coalesce(post.published_at, post.created_at) < activity_day.day + interval '1 day'
          ),
          'comments', (
            select count(*)
            from public_comments as comment
            where comment.created_at >= activity_day.day
              and comment.created_at < activity_day.day + interval '1 day'
          ),
          'creators', (
            select count(*)
            from public_profiles as profile
            where profile.created_at >= activity_day.day
              and profile.created_at < activity_day.day + interval '1 day'
          )
        )
        order by activity_day.day
      )
      from generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', timezone('utc', now())) - make_interval(days => requested_days - 1),
        date_trunc('day', timezone('utc', now())),
        interval '1 day'
      ) as activity_day(day)
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'release_mix', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object('type', release_count.post_type, 'count', release_count.total)
        order by release_count.total desc, release_count.post_type
      )
      from (
        select post.post_type, count(*) as total
        from public_posts as post
        group by post.post_type
      ) as release_count
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'storage_mix', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'provider', storage_count.provider,
          'assets', storage_count.asset_count,
          'bytes', storage_count.total_bytes
        )
        order by storage_count.asset_count desc, storage_count.provider
      )
      from (
        select
          asset.provider,
          count(*) as asset_count,
          coalesce(sum(asset.bytes), 0) as total_bytes
        from public_assets as asset
        group by asset.provider
      ) as storage_count
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'report_statuses', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object('status', report_count.status, 'count', report_count.total)
        order by report_count.status
      )
      from (
        select report.status, count(*) as total
        from public.reports as report
        group by report.status
      ) as report_count
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'recent_releases', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(release_row) order by release_row.activity_at desc)
      from (
        select
          post.id,
          post.title,
          post.post_type,
          post.activity_at,
          profile.id as owner_id,
          profile.username,
          profile.display_name,
          (select count(*) from public.post_hearts as heart where heart.post_id = post.id) as heart_count,
          (select count(*) from public_comments as comment where comment.post_id = post.id) as comment_count
        from public_posts as post
        join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = post.owner_id
        order by post.activity_at desc
        limit 12
      ) as release_row
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'recent_comments', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(comment_row) order by comment_row.created_at desc)
      from (
        select
          comment.id,
          comment.body,
          comment.created_at,
          comment.post_id,
          post.title as post_title,
          profile.id as author_id,
          profile.username,
          profile.display_name,
          (select count(*) from public.comment_hearts as heart where heart.comment_id = comment.id) as heart_count,
          (select count(*) from public_comments as reply where reply.parent_comment_id = comment.id) as reply_count
        from public_comments as comment
        join public_posts as post on post.id = comment.post_id
        join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = comment.author_id
        order by comment.created_at desc
        limit 12
      ) as comment_row
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'recent_creators', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(creator_row) order by creator_row.created_at desc)
      from (
        select
          profile.id,
          profile.username,
          profile.display_name,
          profile.created_at,
          (select count(*) from public_posts as post where post.owner_id = profile.id) as public_release_count
        from public_profiles as profile
        order by profile.created_at desc
        limit 10
      ) as creator_row
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'recent_media', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(media_row) order by media_row.created_at desc)
      from (
        select deduplicated_media.*
        from (
          select distinct on (asset.id)
            asset.id,
            asset.asset_type,
            asset.provider,
            asset.bytes,
            asset.created_at,
            post.id as post_id,
            post.title as post_title
          from public_assets as asset
          join public_asset_usage as usage on usage.asset_id = asset.id
          join public_posts as post on post.id = usage.post_id
          order by asset.id, post.activity_at desc
        ) as deduplicated_media
        order by deduplicated_media.created_at desc
        limit 12
      ) as media_row
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into dashboard;

  return dashboard;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.get_resolved_post_cards(target_post_ids uuid[])
returns table (post_id uuid, card jsonb)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  with requested_posts as (
    select post.*
    from public.posts as post
    where post.id = any(coalesce(target_post_ids, array[]::uuid[]))
      and public.can_view_post(post.id, auth.uid())
    limit 50
  )
  select
    post.id as post_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'post', to_jsonb(post),
      'owner', (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'id', owner.id,
          'username', owner.username,
          'display_name', owner.display_name,
          'bio', null,
          'location', null,
          'website_url', null,
          'instagram_url', null,
          'spotify_url', null,
          'youtube_url', null,
          'support_url', null,
          'avatar_asset_id', owner.avatar_asset_id,
          'pinned_post_id', null,
          'onboarding_completed', true,
          'created_at', owner.created_at,
          'updated_at', owner.updated_at
        )
        from public.profiles as owner
        where owner.id = post.owner_id
      ),
      'artwork', (
        select (to_jsonb(artwork) - 'waveform_peaks')
        from public.assets as artwork
        where artwork.id = post.artwork_asset_id
      ),
      'single', case when post.post_type = 'single' then (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'song', jsonb_build_object(
            'id', song.id,
            'owner_id', song.owner_id,
            'title', song.title,
            'notes', null,
            'lyrics', case when single_link.show_lyrics or post.owner_id = auth.uid() then song.lyrics else null end,
            'musical_key', song.musical_key,
            'tempo_bpm', song.tempo_bpm,
            'tempo_confidence', null,
            'key_confidence', null,
            'audio_analysis_updated_at', song.audio_analysis_updated_at,
            'default_artwork_asset_id', song.default_artwork_asset_id,
            'created_at', song.created_at,
            'updated_at', song.updated_at
          ),
          'showLyrics', single_link.show_lyrics,
          'featuredVersion', to_jsonb(featured_version),
          'previousVersion', (
            select to_jsonb(previous_version)
            from public.song_versions as previous_version
            where previous_version.song_id = single_link.song_id
              and previous_version.id <> single_link.featured_version_id
            order by previous_version.version_number desc
            limit 1
          ),
          'previewAsset', (
            select to_jsonb(preview_asset) || jsonb_build_object(
              'waveform_peaks',
              public.compact_post_card_waveform(preview_asset.waveform_peaks, 320)
            )
            from public.assets as preview_asset
            where preview_asset.id = featured_version.preview_asset_id
          ),
          'protectedPreviewAsset', (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'id', protected_asset.id,
              'owner_id', protected_asset.owner_id,
              'purpose', protected_asset.purpose,
              'status', protected_asset.status,
              'filename', protected_asset.filename,
              'mime_type', protected_asset.mime_type,
              'bytes', protected_asset.bytes,
              'duration_seconds', protected_asset.duration_seconds,
              'waveform_data', public.compact_post_card_waveform(protected_asset.waveform_data, 320),
              'post_id', protected_asset.post_id,
              'project_id', protected_asset.project_id,
              'song_version_id', protected_asset.song_version_id,
              'message_id', protected_asset.message_id,
              'created_at', protected_asset.created_at,
              'ready_at', protected_asset.ready_at
            )
            from public.protected_media_assets as protected_asset
            where protected_asset.song_version_id = featured_version.id
              and protected_asset.status = 'ready'
              and protected_asset.deleted_at is null
            order by protected_asset.ready_at desc nulls last
            limit 1
          ),
          'versionHeartCount', (
            select count(*) from public.version_hearts as heart
            where heart.song_version_id = featured_version.id
          ),
          'viewerHasHeartedVersion', exists (
            select 1 from public.version_hearts as heart
            where heart.song_version_id = featured_version.id
              and heart.profile_id = auth.uid()
          )
        )
        from public.single_posts as single_link
        join public.songs as song on song.id = single_link.song_id
        join public.song_versions as featured_version on featured_version.id = single_link.featured_version_id
        where single_link.post_id = post.id
      ) else null end,
      'releaseTracks', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'track', to_jsonb(track),
            'song', jsonb_build_object(
              'id', song.id,
              'owner_id', song.owner_id,
              'title', song.title,
              'notes', null,
              'lyrics', case when track.show_lyrics or post.owner_id = auth.uid() then song.lyrics else null end,
              'musical_key', song.musical_key,
              'tempo_bpm', song.tempo_bpm,
              'tempo_confidence', null,
              'key_confidence', null,
              'audio_analysis_updated_at', song.audio_analysis_updated_at,
              'default_artwork_asset_id', song.default_artwork_asset_id,
              'created_at', song.created_at,
              'updated_at', song.updated_at
            ),
            'version', case when version.id is null then null else to_jsonb(version) end,
            'versionLabel', version.version_label,
            'previewAsset', case when preview_asset.id is null then null else
              to_jsonb(preview_asset) || jsonb_build_object(
                'waveform_peaks',
                public.compact_post_card_waveform(preview_asset.waveform_peaks, 320)
              )
            end,
            'protectedPreviewAsset', (
              select jsonb_build_object(
                'id', protected_asset.id,
                'owner_id', protected_asset.owner_id,
                'purpose', protected_asset.purpose,
                'status', protected_asset.status,
                'filename', protected_asset.filename,
                'mime_type', protected_asset.mime_type,
                'bytes', protected_asset.bytes,
                'duration_seconds', protected_asset.duration_seconds,
                'waveform_data', public.compact_post_card_waveform(protected_asset.waveform_data, 320),
                'post_id', protected_asset.post_id,
                'project_id', protected_asset.project_id,
                'song_version_id', protected_asset.song_version_id,
                'message_id', protected_asset.message_id,
                'created_at', protected_asset.created_at,
                'ready_at', protected_asset.ready_at
              )
              from public.protected_media_assets as protected_asset
              where protected_asset.song_version_id = track.song_version_id
                and protected_asset.status = 'ready'
                and protected_asset.deleted_at is null
              order by protected_asset.ready_at desc nulls last
              limit 1
            ),
            'versionHeartCount', (
              select count(*) from public.version_hearts as heart
              where heart.song_version_id = track.song_version_id
            ),
            'viewerHasHeartedVersion', exists (
              select 1 from public.version_hearts as heart
              where heart.song_version_id = track.song_version_id
                and heart.profile_id = auth.uid()
            )
          ) order by track.track_number
        )
        from public.release_tracks as track
        join public.songs as song on song.id = track.song_id
        left join public.song_versions as version on version.id = track.song_version_id
        left join public.assets as preview_asset on preview_asset.id = track.preview_asset_id
        where track.post_id = post.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'heartCount', (select count(*) from public.post_hearts as heart where heart.post_id = post.id),
      'viewerHasHearted', exists (
        select 1 from public.post_hearts as heart
        where heart.post_id = post.id and heart.profile_id = auth.uid()
      ),
      'versionHeartCount', case when post.post_type = 'single' then (
        select count(*)
        from public.single_posts as single_link
        join public.version_hearts as heart on heart.song_version_id = single_link.featured_version_id
        where single_link.post_id = post.id
      ) else 0 end,
      'viewerHasHeartedVersion', case when post.post_type = 'single' then exists (
        select 1
        from public.single_posts as single_link
        join public.version_hearts as heart on heart.song_version_id = single_link.featured_version_id
        where single_link.post_id = post.id and heart.profile_id = auth.uid()
      ) else false end,
      'commentCount', (
        select count(*) from public.comments as comment
        where comment.post_id = post.id and comment.deleted_at is null
      ),
      'comments', '[]'::jsonb,
      'credits', '[]'::jsonb,
      'externalLinks', '[]'::jsonb,
      'feedEvent', (
        select to_jsonb(feed_event)
        from public.feed_events as feed_event
        where feed_event.post_id = post.id
        order by feed_event.created_at desc
        limit 1
      )
    ) as card
  from requested_posts as post;
$$;

  insert into public.profiles (id, username, display_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    'user_' || substring(new.id::text from 1 for 8),
    coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name'), ''),
      nullif(btrim(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name'), ''),
      nullif(btrim(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name'), ''),
      'New artist'
    )
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  if accepted_version = '2026-08-05' then
    insert into public.terms_acceptances (profile_id, terms_version, accepted_at)
    values (new.id, accepted_version, timezone('utc', now()))
    on conflict (profile_id) do update
      set terms_version = excluded.terms_version,
          accepted_at = excluded.accepted_at;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

functions.sql:
create or replace function public.list_profile_connections(
  target_profile_id uuid,
  relation text,
  search_query text default null,
  limit_count integer default 50,
  offset_count integer default 0
)
returns table (
  profile_id uuid,
  username text,
  display_name text,
  bio text,
  avatar_asset_id uuid,
  followers_count integer,
  following_count integer,
  public_posts_count integer,
  single_count integer,
  ep_count integer,
  album_count integer,
  follows_you boolean,
  viewer_follows_profile boolean,
  connected_at timestamptz
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  normalized_relation text := lower(relation);
  normalized_search text := nullif(btrim(search_query), '');
begin
  if normalized_relation not in ('followers', 'following') then
    raise exception 'Relation must be followers or following.';
  end if;

  if not public.can_view_profile(target_profile_id, current_user_id)
    or (
      target_profile_id <> current_user_id
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.profile_privacy_settings as target_privacy
        where target_privacy.profile_id = target_profile_id
          and not target_privacy.show_follower_counts
      )
    ) then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with connection_rows as (
    select
      case
        when normalized_relation = 'followers' then follow.follower_id
        else follow.followed_id
      end as related_profile_id,
      follow.created_at as connected_at
    from public.follows as follow
    where (
      normalized_relation = 'followers'
      and follow.followed_id = target_profile_id
    ) or (
      normalized_relation = 'following'
      and follow.follower_id = target_profile_id
    )
  )
  select
    profile.id,
    profile.username,
    profile.display_name,
    profile.bio,
    profile.avatar_asset_id,
    case
      when profile.id = current_user_id or coalesce(privacy.show_follower_counts, true)
        then coalesce(metrics.followers_count, 0)::integer
      else 0
    end,
    case
      when profile.id = current_user_id or coalesce(privacy.show_follower_counts, true)
        then coalesce(metrics.following_count, 0)::integer
      else 0
    end,
    coalesce(metrics.public_posts_count, 0)::integer,
    coalesce(metrics.single_count, 0)::integer,
    coalesce(metrics.ep_count, 0)::integer,
    coalesce(metrics.album_count, 0)::integer,
    public.follows_profile(profile.id, current_user_id),
    public.follows_profile(current_user_id, profile.id),
    connection_rows.connected_at
  from connection_rows
  join public.profiles as profile
    on profile.id = connection_rows.related_profile_id
  left join public.profile_public_metrics as metrics
    on metrics.profile_id = profile.id
  left join public.profile_privacy_settings as privacy
    on privacy.profile_id = profile.id
  where public.can_view_profile(profile.id, current_user_id)
    and (
      normalized_search is null
      or profile.username ilike '%' || normalized_search || '%'
      or profile.display_name ilike '%' || normalized_search || '%'
    )
  order by connection_rows.connected_at desc, profile.display_name asc
  offset greatest(offset_count, 0)
  limit greatest(limit_count, 1);
end;
$$;

set search_path = public, pg_temp

    profile.username,

    profile.bio,
    profile.avatar_asset_id,
    case
      when coalesce(privacy.show_follower_counts, true)
        then coalesce(metrics.followers_count, 0)::integer
      else 0
    end,
    case
      when coalesce(privacy.show_follower_counts, true)
        then coalesce(metrics.following_count, 0)::integer
      else 0
    end,
    coalesce(metrics.public_posts_count, 0)::integer,
    coalesce(metrics.single_count, 0)::integer,

    coalesce(metrics.album_count, 0)::integer,
    public.follows_profile(profile.id, current_user_id),

    case

        then metrics.last_public_activity_at

  from public.profiles as profile

    and metrics.public_posts_count > 0
    and coalesce(privacy.allow_profile_discovery, true)
    and public.can_view_profile(profile.id, current_user_id)
    and (

      or profile.username ilike '%' || normalized_search || '%'

    )
  order by

      when coalesce(privacy.show_activity_status, true)
        then metrics.last_public_activity_at
      else null
    end desc nulls last,
    case
      when coalesce(privacy.show_follower_counts, true)

returns timestamptz
language plpgsql

functions.sql:
create or replace function public.request_account_deletion(
  grace_period_days integer default 14,
  remove_cloud_files boolean default false
)
returns timestamptz
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  scheduled_time timestamptz;
  latest_auth_at bigint;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required.';
  end if;

  select max(
    case
      when jsonb_typeof(method_reference) = 'object'
        and method_reference ? 'timestamp'
      then (method_reference ->> 'timestamp')::bigint
      else null
    end
  )
  into latest_auth_at
  from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(auth.jwt() -> 'amr', '[]'::jsonb))
    as method_reference;

  if latest_auth_at is null
    or latest_auth_at < extract(epoch from timezone('utc', now()) - interval '10 minutes')::bigint
  then
    raise exception 'Recent authentication required.';
  end if;

  scheduled_time := timezone('utc', now())
    + make_interval(days => greatest(1, least(grace_period_days, 30)));

  insert into public.account_deletion_requests (
    profile_id,
    status,
    requested_at,
    scheduled_for,
    cancelled_at,
    completed_at,
    delete_cloud_files
  )
  values (
    auth.uid(),
    'scheduled',
    timezone('utc', now()),
    scheduled_time,
    null,
    null,
    remove_cloud_files
  )
  on conflict (profile_id)
  do update set
    status = 'scheduled',
    requested_at = timezone('utc', now()),
    scheduled_for = excluded.scheduled_for,
    cancelled_at = null,
    completed_at = null,
    delete_cloud_files = excluded.delete_cloud_files;

  update public.profiles
  set
    deactivated_at = timezone('utc', now()),
    deletion_scheduled_at = scheduled_time
  where id = auth.uid();

  return scheduled_time;
end;
$$;

functions.sql:
create or replace function public.reserve_protected_media_asset(
  target_owner_id uuid,
  target_purpose text,
  target_filename text,
  target_mime_type text,
  expected_bytes bigint,
  target_source_asset_id uuid default null,
  target_post_id uuid default null,
  target_project_id uuid default null,
  target_song_version_id uuid default null,
  target_expires_at timestamptz default null
)
returns public.protected_media_assets
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  quota public.protected_media_quotas%rowtype;
  new_asset public.protected_media_assets%rowtype;
  safe_expected_bytes bigint := greatest(coalesce(expected_bytes, 0), 0);
  is_attachment boolean := target_purpose in ('message_audio', 'message_image', 'message_document');
begin
  if target_purpose not in (
    'post_preview',
    'collaboration_preview',
    'message_audio',
    'message_image',
    'message_document',
    'social_preview',
    'data_export'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Unsupported protected media purpose.';
  end if;

  insert into public.protected_media_quotas (profile_id)
  values (target_owner_id)
  on conflict (profile_id) do nothing;

  select *
  into quota
  from public.protected_media_quotas
  where profile_id = target_owner_id
  for update;

  if quota.used_bytes + quota.reserved_bytes + safe_expected_bytes > quota.protected_limit_bytes then
    raise exception 'Protected media quota exceeded.';
  end if;

  if is_attachment
    and quota.attachment_used_bytes + quota.attachment_reserved_bytes + safe_expected_bytes > quota.attachment_limit_bytes then
    raise exception 'Message attachment quota exceeded.';
  end if;

  insert into public.protected_media_assets (
    owner_id,
    storage_key,
    purpose,
    status,
    filename,
    mime_type,
    reserved_bytes,
    source_asset_id,
    post_id,
    project_id,
    song_version_id,
    expires_at
  )
  values (
    target_owner_id,
    lower(target_owner_id::text) || '/' || lower(gen_random_uuid()::text),
    target_purpose,
    'reserved',
    left(regexp_replace(target_filename, '[[:cntrl:]/\\]+', '_', 'g'), 240),
    lower(target_mime_type),
    safe_expected_bytes,
    target_source_asset_id,
    target_post_id,
    target_project_id,
    target_song_version_id,
    target_expires_at
  )
  returning * into new_asset;

  update public.protected_media_quotas
  set
    reserved_bytes = reserved_bytes + safe_expected_bytes,
    attachment_reserved_bytes = attachment_reserved_bytes + case when is_attachment then safe_expected_bytes else 0 end
  where profile_id = target_owner_id;

  return new_asset;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.resolve_shared_post(
  supplied_token text
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  target_link public.share_links%rowtype;
  target_post public.posts%rowtype;
  response jsonb;
begin
  select *
  into target_link
  from public.share_links
  where token_hash = encode(extensions.digest(supplied_token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    and target_type = 'post'
  for update;

  if target_link.id is null
    or not target_link.is_active
    or target_link.revoked_at is not null
    or (target_link.expires_at is not null and target_link.expires_at <= timezone('utc', now()))
    or (target_link.max_uses is not null and target_link.use_count >= target_link.max_uses) then
    raise exception 'This shared release is invalid or has expired.';
  end if;

  select *
  into target_post
  from public.posts
  where id = target_link.target_id
    and hidden_at is null;

  if target_post.id is null then
    raise exception 'This shared release is unavailable.';
  end if;

  update public.share_links
  set use_count = use_count + 1
  where id = target_link.id;

  insert into public.share_link_access_logs (
    share_link_id,
    profile_id,
    access_kind
  )
  values (
    target_link.id,
    auth.uid(),
    'view'
  );

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'post', to_jsonb(post),
    'owner', to_jsonb(owner),
    'artwork', to_jsonb(artwork),
    'single', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'song', to_jsonb(song) || jsonb_build_object(
          'lyrics', case when single_link.show_lyrics then song.lyrics else null end
        ),
        'showLyrics', single_link.show_lyrics,
        'featuredVersion', to_jsonb(version),
        'previewAsset', to_jsonb(preview),
        'protectedAsset', to_jsonb(protected)
      )
      from public.single_posts as single_link
      join public.songs as song on song.id = single_link.song_id
      join public.song_versions as version on version.id = single_link.featured_version_id
      left join public.assets as preview on preview.id = version.preview_asset_id
      left join lateral (
        select protected_asset.*
        from public.protected_media_assets as protected_asset
        where protected_asset.song_version_id = version.id
          and protected_asset.status = 'ready'
          and protected_asset.deleted_at is null
        order by protected_asset.created_at desc
        limit 1
      ) as protected on true
      where single_link.post_id = post.id
    ),
    'releaseTracks', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'track', to_jsonb(track),
          'song', to_jsonb(song) || jsonb_build_object(
            'lyrics', case when track.show_lyrics then song.lyrics else null end
          ),
          'version', to_jsonb(version),
          'previewAsset', to_jsonb(preview),
          'protectedAsset', to_jsonb(protected)
        )
        order by track.track_number
      )
      from public.release_tracks as track
      join public.songs as song on song.id = track.song_id
      left join public.song_versions as version on version.id = track.song_version_id
      left join public.assets as preview on preview.id = track.preview_asset_id
      left join lateral (
        select protected_asset.*
        from public.protected_media_assets as protected_asset
        where protected_asset.song_version_id = track.song_version_id
          and protected_asset.status = 'ready'
          and protected_asset.deleted_at is null
        order by protected_asset.created_at desc
        limit 1
      ) as protected on true
      where track.post_id = post.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'credits', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(credit) order by credit.position)
      from public.post_credits as credit
      where credit.post_id = post.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'externalLinks', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(link) order by link.position)
      from public.post_external_links as link
      where link.post_id = post.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into response
  from public.posts as post
  join public.profiles as owner on owner.id = post.owner_id
  left join public.assets as artwork on artwork.id = post.artwork_asset_id
  where post.id = target_post.id;

  return response;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.resolve_shared_project(supplied_token text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  target_link public.share_links%rowtype;
  target_project_id uuid;
  response jsonb;
begin
  select * into target_link
  from public.share_links
  where token_hash = encode(extensions.digest(supplied_token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    and target_type in ('collaboration_project', 'song_version')
  for update;

  if target_link.id is null
    or not target_link.is_active
    or target_link.revoked_at is not null
    or (target_link.expires_at is not null and target_link.expires_at <= timezone('utc', now()))
    or (target_link.max_uses is not null and target_link.use_count >= target_link.max_uses) then
    raise exception 'This shared project is invalid or has expired.';
  end if;

  if target_link.target_type = 'collaboration_project' then
    target_project_id := target_link.target_id;
  else
    select collaboration_project_id into target_project_id
    from public.song_versions
    where id = target_link.target_id;
  end if;

  if target_project_id is null or not exists (
    select 1 from public.collaboration_projects
    where id = target_project_id and archived_at is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'This shared project is unavailable.';
  end if;

  update public.share_links
  set use_count = use_count + 1
  where id = target_link.id;

  insert into public.share_link_access_logs (share_link_id, profile_id, access_kind)
  values (target_link.id, auth.uid(), case when target_link.permission = 'review' then 'review' else 'view' end);

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'targetType', target_link.target_type,
    'targetId', target_link.target_id,
    'permission', target_link.permission,
    'project', to_jsonb(project),
    'owner', to_jsonb(owner),
    'tracks', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'track', to_jsonb(track),
          'song', to_jsonb(song),
          'version', to_jsonb(version),
          'protectedAsset', to_jsonb(protected_asset)
        )
        order by track.track_number
      )
      from public.collaboration_project_tracks as track
      join public.songs as song on song.id = track.song_id
      left join public.song_versions as version
        on version.id = case
          when target_link.target_type = 'song_version' then target_link.target_id
          else track.active_version_id
        end
        and version.song_id = track.song_id
      left join public.protected_media_assets as protected_asset
        on protected_asset.id = version.protected_preview_asset_id
        and protected_asset.status = 'ready'
        and protected_asset.deleted_at is null
      where track.project_id = project.id
        and (
          target_link.target_type = 'collaboration_project'
          or version.id = target_link.target_id
        )
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'feedbackThreads', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(thread) order by thread.start_seconds)
      from public.feedback_threads as thread
      where thread.project_id = project.id
        and (
          target_link.target_type = 'collaboration_project'
          or thread.song_version_id = target_link.target_id
        )
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into response
  from public.collaboration_projects as project
  join public.profiles as owner on owner.id = project.owner_id
  where project.id = target_project_id;

  return response;
end;
$$;

as $$
declare
  result_profile public.profiles%rowtype;

  normalized_location text := nullif(btrim(next_location), '');
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required.';
  end if;

  select coalesce(show_location, true)
  into location_is_public
  from public.profile_privacy_settings
  where profile_id = auth.uid();

  location_is_public := coalesce(location_is_public, true);

  update public.profiles
  set
    display_name = btrim(next_display_name),
    username = lower(btrim(next_username)),
    bio = nullif(btrim(next_bio), ''),
    location = case when location_is_public then normalized_location else null end,
    website_url = nullif(btrim(next_website_url), ''),
    instagram_url = nullif(btrim(next_instagram_url), ''),
    spotify_url = nullif(btrim(next_spotify_url), ''),

    onboarding_completed = true

  returning * into result_profile;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Profile not found.';
  end if;

  update public.profile_privacy_settings
  set private_location = case when location_is_public then null else normalized_location end
  where profile_id = auth.uid();

  result_profile.location := normalized_location;
  return result_profile;
end;

create or replace function public.search_public_catalog(
  raw_query text,
  limit_count integer default 24,
  offset_count integer default 0
)
returns table (
  result_kind text,
  profile_id uuid,
  post_id uuid,
  username text,
  display_name text,
  title text,
  description text,
  post_type text,
  activity_at timestamptz,
  followers_count integer
)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  normalized_query text := nullif(btrim(raw_query), '');
begin
  if normalized_query is null then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with creator_matches as (
    select
      'creator'::text as result_kind,
      profiles.id as profile_id,
      null::uuid as post_id,
      profiles.username,
      profiles.display_name,
      profiles.display_name as title,
      profiles.bio as description,
      null::text as post_type,
      metrics.last_public_activity_at as activity_at,
      metrics.followers_count
    from public.profiles
    join public.profile_public_metrics as metrics
      on metrics.profile_id = profiles.id
    where metrics.public_posts_count > 0
      and (
        profiles.username ilike '%' || normalized_query || '%'
        or profiles.display_name ilike '%' || normalized_query || '%'
      )
  ),
  post_matches as (
    select
      'post'::text as result_kind,
      posts.owner_id as profile_id,
      posts.id as post_id,
      profiles.username,
      profiles.display_name,
      posts.title,
      posts.description,
      posts.post_type::text,
      posts.activity_at,
      metrics.followers_count
    from public.posts
    join public.profiles
      on profiles.id = posts.owner_id
    left join public.profile_public_metrics as metrics
      on metrics.profile_id = posts.owner_id
    left join public.single_posts
      on single_posts.post_id = posts.id
    left join public.songs
      on songs.id = single_posts.song_id
    left join public.release_tracks
      on release_tracks.post_id = posts.id
    where posts.visibility = 'public'
      and (
        posts.title ilike '%' || normalized_query || '%'
        or coalesce(posts.description, '') ilike '%' || normalized_query || '%'
        or coalesce(songs.title, '') ilike '%' || normalized_query || '%'
        or coalesce(release_tracks.track_title, '') ilike '%' || normalized_query || '%'
        or coalesce(release_tracks.production_stage, '') ilike '%' || normalized_query || '%'
      )
    group by posts.id, profiles.id, metrics.followers_count
  )
  select *
  from (
    select * from creator_matches
    union all
    select * from post_matches
  ) combined
  order by combined.activity_at desc nulls last, combined.followers_count desc nulls last, combined.title asc
  offset greatest(offset_count, 0)
  limit greatest(limit_count, 1);
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.search_v2_catalog(
  raw_query text,
  result_limit integer default 40
)
returns table (
  result_kind text,
  result_id uuid,
  context_id uuid,
  title text,
  subtitle text,
  rank real
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  trimmed_query text := nullif(btrim(raw_query), '');
  compact_query text := lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(btrim(raw_query), ''), '[^[:alnum:]]+', '', 'g'));
  query_value tsquery := websearch_to_tsquery('simple', raw_query);
begin
  if current_user_id is null or trimmed_query is null then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with results as (
    select
      'creator'::text,
      profile.id,
      null::uuid,
      profile.display_name,
      '@' || profile.username,
      greatest(
        ts_rank(
          to_tsvector(
            'simple',
            coalesce(profile.username, '') || ' ' ||
            coalesce(profile.display_name, '') || ' ' ||
            coalesce(profile.bio, '')
          ),
          query_value
        ),
        similarity(profile.username, trimmed_query),
        similarity(profile.display_name, trimmed_query),
        similarity(
          lower(regexp_replace(profile.username || profile.display_name, '[^[:alnum:]]+', '', 'g')),
          compact_query
        )
      )::real
    from public.profiles as profile
    left join public.profile_privacy_settings as privacy on privacy.profile_id = profile.id
    where public.can_view_profile(profile.id, current_user_id)
      and coalesce(privacy.allow_profile_discovery, true)
      and not public.is_profile_suspended(profile.id)
      and (
        to_tsvector(
          'simple',
          coalesce(profile.username, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(profile.display_name, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(profile.bio, '')
        ) @@ query_value
        or profile.username ilike '%' || trimmed_query || '%'
        or profile.display_name ilike '%' || trimmed_query || '%'
        or profile.username % trimmed_query
        or profile.display_name % trimmed_query
        or (
          compact_query <> ''
          and (
            lower(regexp_replace(profile.username || profile.display_name, '[^[:alnum:]]+', '', 'g'))
              ilike '%' || compact_query || '%'
            or lower(regexp_replace(profile.username || profile.display_name, '[^[:alnum:]]+', '', 'g'))
              % compact_query
          )
        )
      )

    union all

    select
      'release'::text,
      post.id,
      post.id,
      post.title,
      profile.display_name,
      ts_rank(
        to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(post.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(post.description, '') || ' ' || coalesce(post.release_notes, '')),
        query_value
      )
    from public.posts as post
    join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = post.owner_id
    where public.can_view_post(post.id, current_user_id)
      and post.hidden_at is null
      and to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(post.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(post.description, '') || ' ' || coalesce(post.release_notes, '')) @@ query_value

    union all

    select
      'song'::text,
      song.id,
      song.id,
      song.title,
      case when song.owner_id = current_user_id then 'Your private library' else 'Shared music' end,
      ts_rank(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(song.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(song.notes, '')), query_value)
    from public.songs as song
    where (
        song.owner_id = current_user_id
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.collaboration_project_tracks as track
          where track.song_id = song.id
            and public.can_view_collaboration_project(track.project_id, current_user_id)
        )
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.single_posts as single_post
          where single_post.song_id = song.id
            and public.can_view_post(single_post.post_id, current_user_id)
        )
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.release_tracks as release_track
          where release_track.song_id = song.id
            and public.can_view_post(release_track.post_id, current_user_id)
        )
      )
      and to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(song.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(song.notes, '')) @@ query_value

    union all

    select
      'project'::text,
      project.id,
      project.id,
      project.title,
      project.status,
      ts_rank(
        to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(project.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(project.description, '')),
        query_value
      )
    from public.collaboration_projects as project
    where public.can_view_collaboration_project(project.id, current_user_id)
      and to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(project.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(project.description, '')) @@ query_value

    union all

    select
      'project'::text,
      feedback.id,
      feedback.project_id,
      coalesce(feedback.title, 'Feedback at ' || round(feedback.start_seconds)::text || 's'),
      left(feedback.body, 180),
      ts_rank(
        to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(feedback.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(feedback.body, '')),
        query_value
      )
    from public.feedback_threads as feedback
    where public.can_review_project(feedback.project_id, current_user_id)
      and to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(feedback.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(feedback.body, '')) @@ query_value

    union all

    select
      'release'::text,
      credit.id,
      credit.post_id,
      credit.display_name,
      credit.role,
      similarity(credit.display_name, raw_query)::real
    from public.post_credits as credit
    where public.can_view_post(credit.post_id, current_user_id)
      and credit.display_name % raw_query

    union all

    select
      'message'::text,
      message.id,
      message.conversation_id,
      left(message.body, 100),
      'Message in your conversation',
      ts_rank(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(message.body, '')), query_value)
    from public.messages as message
    where message.deleted_at is null
      and public.is_conversation_member(message.conversation_id, current_user_id)
      and to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(message.body, '')) @@ query_value
  )
  select *
  from results
  order by rank desc, title
  limit greatest(1, least(result_limit, 100));
end;
$$;

as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  target_song_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.can_edit_collaboration_project(target_project_id, current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'You cannot select versions for this project.';

  from public.collaboration_project_tracks

    and project_id = target_project_id;

  target_project_id uuid,
  next_owner_id uuid
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if public.collaboration_member_role(target_project_id, current_user_id) <> 'owner' then
    raise exception 'Only the project owner can transfer ownership.';
  end if;

  if public.collaboration_member_role(target_project_id, next_owner_id) is null then
    raise exception 'The next owner must be an accepted project member.';
  end if;

  update public.collaboration_project_members
  set role = 'admin'
  where project_id = target_project_id
    and profile_id = current_user_id;

  update public.collaboration_project_members
  set role = 'owner'
  where project_id = target_project_id
    and profile_id = next_owner_id;

  update public.collaboration_projects
  set owner_id = next_owner_id
  where id = target_project_id;

  insert into public.collaboration_activity (
    project_id,
    actor_id,
    activity_type,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    target_project_id,
    current_user_id,
    'ownership_transferred',
    'profile',
    next_owner_id,
    jsonb_build_object('previous_owner_id', current_user_id)
  );
end;
$$;

  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();

  next_project_invite_permission text,
  next_show_location boolean,
  next_show_follower_counts boolean,
  next_show_activity_status boolean,
  next_allow_profile_discovery boolean
)
returns public.profile_privacy_settings
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  updated_settings public.profile_privacy_settings%rowtype;
  current_public_location text;
  current_private_location text;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required.';
  end if;

  select profile.location, privacy.private_location
  into current_public_location, current_private_location
  from public.profiles as profile
  left join public.profile_privacy_settings as privacy
    on privacy.profile_id = profile.id
  where profile.id = auth.uid();

  insert into public.profile_privacy_settings (
    profile_id,
    profile_visibility,
    message_permission,
    project_invite_permission,
    show_location,
    show_follower_counts,
    show_activity_status,
    allow_profile_discovery,
    private_location
  )
  values (
    auth.uid(),
    next_profile_visibility,
    next_message_permission,
    next_project_invite_permission,
    next_show_location,
    next_show_follower_counts,
    next_show_activity_status,
    next_allow_profile_discovery,
    case
      when next_show_location then null
      else coalesce(current_public_location, current_private_location)
    end
  )
  on conflict (profile_id)
  do update set
    profile_visibility = excluded.profile_visibility,
    message_permission = excluded.message_permission,
    project_invite_permission = excluded.project_invite_permission,
    show_location = excluded.show_location,
    show_follower_counts = excluded.show_follower_counts,
    show_activity_status = excluded.show_activity_status,
    allow_profile_discovery = excluded.allow_profile_discovery,
    private_location = excluded.private_location
  returning * into updated_settings;

  if next_show_location then
    update public.profiles
    set location = coalesce(current_public_location, current_private_location)
    where id = auth.uid();
  else
    update public.profiles
    set location = null
    where id = auth.uid();
  end if;

  return updated_settings;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.update_project_status(
  target_project_id uuid,
  next_status text
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  previous_status text;
begin
  if not public.can_edit_collaboration_project(target_project_id, current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'You cannot update this project.';
  end if;

  if next_status not in ('planning', 'active', 'review', 'finalizing', 'completed', 'archived') then
    raise exception 'Unsupported project status.';
  end if;

  select status into previous_status
  from public.collaboration_projects
  where id = target_project_id
  for update;

  update public.collaboration_projects
  set
    status = next_status,
    archived_at = case
      when next_status = 'archived' then timezone('utc', now())
      else null
    end
  where id = target_project_id;

  insert into public.collaboration_activity (
    project_id,
    actor_id,
    activity_type,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    target_project_id,
    current_user_id,
    case when next_status = 'archived' then 'project_archived' else 'status_changed' end,
    'project',
    target_project_id,
    jsonb_build_object('previous_status', previous_status, 'status', next_status)
  );

  insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type, project_id)
  select
    member.profile_id,
    current_user_id,
    'project_status_changed',
    target_project_id
  from public.collaboration_project_members as member
  where member.project_id = target_project_id
    and member.membership_status = 'accepted'
    and member.profile_id <> current_user_id;
end;
$$;
